📚 Rajasthan University 1st Semester 2023 | Discrete Mathematics & Optimization Techniques – Complete Paper Solution

क्या आप Rajasthan University B.Sc./B.A. 1st Semester के लिए **Discrete Mathematics & Optimization Techniques** की तैयारी कर रहे हैं? 🎯

इस वीडियो में **December 2023 Rajasthan University Question Paper** के **पूरे प्रश्नपत्र की Comprehensive Solution** दी गई है। प्रत्येक प्रश्न को step-by-step और आसान भाषा में समझाया गया है, ताकि आप concepts को समझने के साथ-साथ exam में solution लिखने का सही तरीका भी सीख सकें। ✍️📖

🎯 यह वीडियो विशेष रूप से इन विद्यार्थियों के लिए उपयोगी है:
📘 Rajasthan University B.Sc. Mathematics Students  
📘 B.A. Mathematics Students  
📘 B.Sc. 1st Semester Students  
📘 Discrete Mathematics & Optimization Techniques के विद्यार्थी  
📘 University Exam की तैयारी करने वाले Students  
📘 Previous Year Paper से तैयारी करने वाले Students  

✅ इस वीडियो में पूरे Question Paper के Problems Solve किए गए हैं।

⏱️ TIMESTAMPS:
00:00 – Introduction & Paper Overview (Rajasthan University 2022–23 Paper)
01:23 – Part A: Short Answer Type Questions
01:24 – Q1 (a): Define Partial Order Relation
03:40 – Q1 (b): Boolean Algebra Proof ($a + ab = a$)
05:05 – Q1 (c): Negation of Biconditional Statement ($p \leftrightarrow q$)
06:37 – Q1 (d): Generating Function of Numeric Function $a_r = \binom{r+5}{r}$
08:30 – Q1 (e): Solve Recurrence Relation $a_r = a_{r-1} + 2a_{r-2}$
10:40 – Q1 (f): Define Complete Bipartite Graph
14:11 – Q1 (g): Number of Edges in a $k$-Regular Graph with $n$ Vertices
16:04 – Q1 (h): Define Self-Complementary Graph
17:36 – Q1 (i): Define Binary Tree
18:41 – Q1 (j): Define Basic Feasible Solution (LPP)
20:41 – Part B: Long Answer Type Questions
21:00 – Q2: Prove Relation $x + 3y = 12$ on $\mathbb{N}$ is Transitive but Neither Reflexive nor Symmetric
34:47 – Q3: Find the Generating Function of Sequence ${n^2}$ ($0^2, 1^2, 2^2, \dots$)
41:44 – Q4: Prove Simple Graph $G$ has a Hamiltonian Cycle if $m \ge \frac{1}{2}(n^2 - 3n + 6)$
53:26 – Q5: Prove the Set of Convex Combinations of Points is a Convex Set
01:01:15 – Part C: Unit-Wise Long Questions
01:01:19 – Unit I
01:01:22 – Q6 (a): Distributive Lattice Identities Proof
01:12:08 – Q6 (b): Number of Integers between 1 and 1000 Not Divisible by 2, 3, 5, 7 (Inclusion-Exclusion)
01:26:18 – Q6 (Or - a): Verify Boolean Algebra Identities
01:34:12 – Q6 (Or - b): Logical Inference & Argument Validity Test
01:43:12 – Unit II
01:43:15 – Q7 (a): Generating Function of $a_r = (r+3)(r+2)(r+1)$
01:48:58 – Q7 (b): Complete Solution of Recurrence Relation $a_r + 5a_{r-1} + 6a_{r-2} = 6r^2 - 6r + 1$
01:59:55 – Q7 (Or - a): Prove Vertices in Self-Complementary Graph are of Form $4m$ or $4m+1$
02:09:32 – Q7 (Or - b): Prove Graph with $k$ Connected Components has At Most $\frac{1}{2}(n-k)(n-k+1)$ Edges
02:20:50 – Unit III
02:20:53 – Q8 (a): Simple Planar Graph has a Vertex with $\deg(v) \le 5$
02:32:05 – Q8 (b): Construct Directed Graph from Incidence Matrix
02:41:40 – Q8 (Or - a): Tree Degree Formula Proof ($n_1 = n_3 + 2n_4 + \dots + 2$)
02:47:57 – Q8 (Or - b): Graph is Connected iff it has a Spanning Tree
03:02:35 – Unit IV
03:02:39 – Q9 (a): Solve Linear Programming Problem (LPP) using Big-M Simplex Method
03:30:55 – Q9 (b): Optimal Solution for Transportation Problem (MODI Method / UV Method)
03:53:40 – Q9 (Or - a): Solve LPP using Duality Method
04:13:15 – Q9 (Or - b): Assignment Problem for Maximum Profit (Hungarian Method)
04:34:25 – Conclusion & Next Video Preview


💡 अगर आप Rajasthan University के **Discrete Mathematics & Optimization Techniques 2023 Question Paper** को पूरी तरह समझना चाहते हैं, तो इस वीडियो को अंत तक जरूर देखें।

👉 https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLHoWYh3APMj4PW05kDQMZtLgSWrvgk1VA

Discrete Mathematics & Optimization Techniques-I | Rajasthan University B.Sc. 1st Semester
👉 https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQ52CPTUPzQs
